name: openoutreach
description: An open-source, self-hosted AI agent designed for B2B lead generation. It allows users to describe their product, automatically finds matching potential leads, explains why each lead fits the product, and sends personalized emails from the user's mailbox via a command-line interface with a single installation.

inputs.name: product_description
inputs.description: A detailed textual description of the user's product or service to identify suitable leads.

inputs.name: email_credentials
inputs.description: User's mailbox configuration and authentication details needed to send emails.

inputs.name: lead_criteria
inputs.description: Optional filters or parameters that specify characteristics of the desired leads.

inputs.name: CLI_commands
inputs.description: Commands or flags provided through the command-line interface to control the agent's operation.

outputs.name: lead_list
outputs.description: A list of identified potential leads including matching rationale for each.

outputs.name: email_reports
outputs.description: Status and logs of emails sent from the user's mailbox to respective leads.

outputs.name: explanations
outputs.description: Textual explanations detailing why each lead matches the product description.

steps: User installs the CLI application with a single command.
User provides a detailed product description via CLI input.
AI agent analyzes the product description to identify characteristics and ideal lead profiles.
The agent searches and finds matching leads based on defined criteria.
For each lead, the agent generates an explanation of why the lead matches the product.
Agent composes personalized outreach emails for the leads.
Emails are dispatched from the user's mailbox using the provided email credentials.
Agent provides a report on email sending status and logs.
use_cases: Automated B2B sales prospecting and lead generation.
Personalized email outreach campaigns for business development.
Startups and small businesses seeking targeted customer acquisition without third-party SaaS.
Sales teams wanting self-hosted solutions for lead management and outreach.
Companies aiming to maintain data privacy by self-hosting their lead generation pipeline.
patterns: Self-hosted CLI application for ease of deployment and control
Lead explanation to increase transparency and trust
Direct integration with user mailbox for email dispatch

prompt_templates.name: product_description_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Describe your product or service in detail to find matching leads: {product_description}

prompt_templates.name: lead_explanation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Explain why the following lead fits the product description: {lead_data}

prompt_templates.name: email_compose_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Compose a personalized outreach email for the lead named {lead_name} based on the product description: {product_description}
